description: This is a test class for the StorageService in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing storage-related functionalities such as saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting data files in a storage system.

classes.name: BaseStorageServiceTest
classes.description: An abstract test class for StorageService implementations, providing common setup and utility methods for testing storage functionalities.

methods.name: newStorageService
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate a new StorageService, implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test runs, including setting up input streams and the storage service.

methods.name: saveTestData
methods.description: Saves test data into storage with optional module ID and key suffix, then runs verification.

methods.name: saveTestData
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts InputStream data for saving test files.

methods.name: saveTempData
methods.description: Saves temporary data and verifies its retrieval.

methods.name: getData_shouldThrowExceptionWhenFileDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that requesting data for a nonexistent file throws IOException.

methods.name: getData_shouldReturnDataWhenFileExists
methods.description: Verifies correct data retrieval when the file exists.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataIfNoModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Tests that data is persisted correctly without specifying module ID or key suffix.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataWithModuleId
methods.description: Checks that data saved with a module ID is stored appropriately.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataWithModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Ensures data saved with a module ID and key suffix is stored correctly.

methods.name: saveData_shouldFailIfModuleIdAndKeySuffixExists
methods.description: Asserts that saving data with an existing key suffix within the same module throws a FileAlreadyExistsException.

methods.name: saveData_shouldPersistDataIfModuleIdDiffersButKeySuffixSame
methods.description: Verifies that data can be saved with same key suffix in different modules.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithGivenModuleIdAndKeySuffix
methods.description: Tests that the system lists correct files matching module ID and key suffix.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithGivenModuleIdAndKeySuffixWithoutDirs
methods.description: Checks listing of files without directories.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesWithoutGivenModuleIdAndWithKeySuffix
methods.description: Verifies listing files matching a key suffix regardless of module ID.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesOnlyForGivenModule
methods.description: Tests that only files for a specific module are listed.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesOnlyForGlobal
methods.description: Checks that only global files are listed when module ID is null.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListFilesAndDirsOnlyForCurrentDir
methods.description: Verifies listing files and directories in a specified directory.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromDir
methods.description: Checks comprehensive listing from a specific directory.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromRoot
methods.description: Verifies listing all files and directories from root.

methods.name: getKeys_shouldListAllFilesAndDirsFromParentDirOnly
methods.description: Tests listing files and directories within a parent directory.

methods.name: purgeData_shouldReturnTrueWhenDeleted
methods.description: Tests that data deletion returns true when a file is successfully deleted.

methods.name: purgeData_shouldReturnFalseIfNotExists
methods.description: Verifies that deleting a non-existent file returns false.

methods.name: exists_shouldReturnTrueWhenFileExists
methods.description: Checks that the existence check returns true for existing files.

methods.name: exists_shouldReturnFalseWhenFileMissing
methods.description: Verifies that the existence check returns false for missing files.

methods.name: saveData_shouldHandleWindowsPathSeparatorInKey
methods.description: Tests that saveData handles Windows path separator characters correctly.

methods.name: saveData_shouldNotFailIfModuleIdOrGroupContainsAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Ensures saveData doesn't fail with allowed characters in module ID or group.

methods.name: saveData_shouldFailIfModuleIdOrGroupContainsBadCharacters
methods.description: Checks that saveData fails when illegal characters are included in module ID or group.

methods.name: saveData_shouldNotCreateFileIfErrorOccursWhenCopyingData
methods.description: Ensures that no file is created if an error occurs during data copying.
